description: Calls GET /v1/templates. Returns a page of templates matching optional `name`/`tags`/`status` filters (`{ items, nextCursor }`). Use this to discover or search templates when you don't already know the `templateId`; if you already have the id, call jsonfabrica_get_template directly instead — it is cheaper and returns the full record. This is read-only and has no side effects. Pass `status: "archived"` to see templates previously removed with jsonfabrica_delete_template, since the default `active` filter excludes them.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor taken verbatim from a previous response's `nextCursor`. Optional; omit to fetch the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return in this page. Optional; defaults to 20 when omitted. Values <= 0 or > 100 are not clamped — the request is rejected with a 400 validation error.

name.description: Filters to templates whose `name` contains this text — a case-insensitive substring match, not an exact match. Optional; omit to match templates of any name.

status.description: `active` returns only non-deleted templates, `archived` returns only soft-deleted ones. Optional; defaults to `active` when omitted (archived templates are excluded unless requested).

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags, e.g. "orders,email". AND-match: a template must contain every listed tag to be included (not "any of"). Optional; omit to ignore tags entirely.

name: jsonfabrica_list_templates

astCache.description: Server-internal parsed-body cache; opaque to callers.

description.description: Free-text description, if any was stored.

validated.description: Whether the body passed static template validation.

nextCursor.description: Pass to `cursor` on the next call to fetch the following page; absent on the last page.

title: List JsonFabrica templates
